prompts.name: city
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: Thai editorial news website category tile. Create one sharp, high resolution portrait photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio. Warm natural light, realistic textures, candid refined documentary photography, coherent editorial style. Subject must be immediately recognizable at small thumbnail size, centered within middle 70 percent, lower quarter slightly quieter for website text overlay. No text, lettering, logo, watermark, frames or collage. Scene: charming Bangkok neighborhood community cafe opening onto a walkable old shophouse lane, a few Thai neighbors chatting at a small outdoor table, greenery and textured facades. Emphasize the welcoming shared urban space.
